t: Dual-sided, textured scrub and clean wipes with bio-based cleansers to quickly and effectively remove stubborn industrial muck and grime. Easily removes paint, oil, PU foam, silicone, grease, gap fill, adhesive and sealant from hands, tools and surfaces. High adhesion scrub side grabs the grime, smooth side soaks up any leftover muck. Featuring closed-cell fabric technology to capture and contain dirt and grime without releasing it. Free of artificial preservatives, parabens, sulphates, phosphates and formaldehyde. CDermatologically tested with Aloe Vera and Vitamin E to protect and nourish hands.
b: For Medium to Heavy Duty Work
